entries.title: Baylight Legal Instruments: Environmental Remediation Bond & Tax Increment Financing for Infrastructure
entries.text: BAYLIGHT LEGAL INSTRUMENTS FILED (C84). Instrument BD-83-REB: Environmental Remediation Performance Bond Certificate, executed by Keisha Ramos. Ordinance BD-83-TIF: Tax Increment Financing framework, prepared by Dr. Simone Ellis. TIF establishes 30-year financing zone across 65 acres. Property tax increment flows to Baylight Infrastructure Fund. Authorized uses: environmental remediation, shoreline stabilization, water/sewer, utility installation, transit integration (BART pedestrian bridge, ferry terminal expansion, AC Transit priority lanes), roadway improvements, stadium-adjacent public works/open space, admin costs capped at 3%. Independent Audit Commission conducts annual reviews. Community Benefits Oversight Board receives quarterly reports. Environmental review confirmed by Dr. Leanne Wu, Director of Office of Environmental Review and Sustainability.
